fields.description: Stored save checksum: seed 0x67 plus byte sum over save offsets [0x04, 0xAC0). Loaded by FUN_08014560, maintained incrementally by FUN_08014578, recomputed by FUN_08014cb8.
fields.evidence: FUN_08014560 loads 4B from SRAM 0x0E000000+0x00 into RAM checksum word; FUN_08014578 maintains running int byte-sum (adds new byte, subtracts old byte) and flushes via FUN_08014530; FUN_08014cb8 recomputes from seed 0x67. Verified: sum32_le over [4,2752) with seed 103 gives expected=actual=95763 in baseline.sav.
fields.name: save_checksum

fields.description: Primary mission/progress flag array: bit (flag>>3) byte, (flag&7) mask. Init sets flags 0x00,0x04,0x08,0x0C,0x12,0x15,0x1A,0x1D,0x1E,0x23,0x26,0x2D,0x2E,0x2F; upper two bytes reserved zero.
fields.evidence: FUN_08014944 bit-set/clear at ((flag>>3)+RAM+0x0C) via single-byte FUN_08014578 writes; FUN_080148d0 bit-tests ((flag>>3)+RAM+0x0C) incl. flags 0x13/0x17 in FUN_08014a84/FUN_08014a90; init FUN_080146ac sets 14 flags max 0x2F (6 bytes); baseline bytes [0x0C,0x12) = 11 11 24 64 48 E0 match init set bit-exactly.
fields.name: progress_flags_a

fields.description: Secondary event flag array: bit (flag>>3) byte, (flag&7) mask, flag index range-checked < 0x21; this covers flags 0-31, flag 32 lives in event_flag_32. Gameplay sets flag 1.
fields.evidence: FUN_080149c4 range-guards param_1 < 0x21 and RMW ((flag>>3)+RAM+0x14) via FUN_08014578; literal gameplay call (1,1) matches baseline [0x14] = 0x02 (flag 1 set, rest clear).
fields.name: event_flags_b

fields.description: Top byte of the secondary event flag array: holds flag 32 only (flag index range-checked < 0x21, so bits 1-7 are never set).
fields.evidence: FUN_080149c4 range-guards param_1 < 0x21 (33 flags); byte index (32>>3)=4 lands at save offset 0x14+4=0x18; written via FUN_08014578; baseline 0x00.
fields.name: event_flag_32

fields.description: Active leaderboard/standings entry index into the 48-entry x 12-byte runtime table.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801487c reads *(u16*)(RAM+0xF0) as table index passed to FUN_0801501c (base+idx*0x0C+0x90) and FUN_08014f44; table loops bound 0x30 (48) in FUN_0801487c/FUN_08014f70; save RAM+0xF0 mirrors save offset 0xF0 (consistent +offset mirror layout); baseline 12 < 48.
fields.name: table_cursor_index

fields.description: Career/best-records table: 197 variable-length records of ASCII initials + two u32 values (12-byte {name,u32,u32}, or 16-byte {name,8,u32,u32} when tag word is 8), spanning [0x100,0xABC).
fields.evidence: Bulk-loaded by FUN_0801464c (0x1540 bytes via FUN_08014530) after header load FUN_08014618 (0xF4 bytes); region covered by FUN_08014cb8 checksum over [4,0xAC0); 197 records consume [0x100,0xABC) exactly with names matching [A-Z.]{2,3} NUL pattern (e.g. TJO/MTO/TCH at 0x13C/0x14C/0x158).
fields.name: record_table
